comparison: Perfect alignment on dark core formation claims (C60-C67, C104-C106). Both evaluations support the finding that spheroid thickness correlates with dark core formation at consistent height (~250±15 μm) despite variable timing across seeding densities. Both emphasize the advantage of side-view observation for detecting this relationship.

Perfect alignment on background/literature review claims (C1-C14). Both evaluations accept these foundational statements about 3D spheroid advantages and limitations of existing imaging methods. Peer reviewers implicitly validated these claims by accepting the device's motivation and design.

Strong alignment on NK cell treatment effects (C82-C93, C114-C117). Both evaluations support the detailed time-course observations showing NK cell infiltration and spheroid collapse with 37% decrease in height-to-width ratio. OpenEval includes C118 (protocol design implications) which peer reviewers did not explicitly address but implicitly accepted through their positive assessment.

Strong alignment on spheroid formation tracking (C38-C43, C45, C100-C102). Both evaluations support the time-course observations and non-destructive monitoring capability. OpenEval includes C44 (contrast with destructive methods) which peer reviewers addressed separately in R11. Peer reviewers explicitly highlighted real-time tracking as a key strength.

Strong alignment on dark core background claims (C57-C59). Both evaluations accept these as established principles providing context for experimental observations. OpenEval R11 also includes C129-C131 (drug testing background), which peer reviewers addressed in R11.

Strong alignment on cell migration analysis (C46-C56). Both evaluations support the quantitative measurements showing outer cell participation in migration while inner core remains stable. Peer reviewers specifically highlighted this as a key strength. OpenEval includes additional background claims (C102-C103, C124-C125) not explicitly mentioned by peer reviewers.

Strong alignment on spheroid fusion tracking (C68-C75, C107-C108). Both evaluations support the multi-angle observation capability revealing 3D structural details. OpenEval includes background claims (C126-C128) about fusion importance, which peer reviewers addressed in R11. Peer reviewers emphasized multi-angle advantage.

Strong alignment on device fabrication and optical validation (C15, C21-C31, C99, C119-C121, C123). Both evaluations support the device design and optical characterization. OpenEval includes additional claims about medium effects and lighting optimization (C20, C32-C37) which peer reviewers addressed in R10. Reviewers praised the 'ingenious' and 'wonderful' design.

Strong alignment on DOX treatment effects (C76-C81, C96, C109, C111-C113). Both evaluations support the observation that DOX induces surface changes while preserving overall 3D structure. OpenEval's interpretation about cell death mechanism (C113) was accepted by peer reviewers. Peer reviewers grouped this with NK cell comparison (C94-C95, C97-C98, C110) which OpenEval addressed separately in R8.

Partial overlap on technical optimization details (C20, C32-C37). OpenEval R1 includes these as part of comprehensive device validation. Peer reviewers confirmed methods work as described but did not separately evaluate these specific optimization parameters, grouping them with overall methodological acceptance.

Alignment on drug testing background context (C129-C131). Both evaluations accept these cited background claims about DOX and NK cells. Peer R11 also includes other background claims (C44, C103, C122, C124-C128) that OpenEval distributed across R2, R3, and R5.

Partial overlap on comparative analysis of DOX vs NK effects (C94, C98). OpenEval R8 synthesizes the contrasting mechanisms as a separate evaluation. Peer reviewers integrated this comparison within their R6 evaluation of drug testing applications, also including C19, C76-C81, C95-C97, C109-C113, C117.

Minimal overlap on application overview (C16). OpenEval R10 groups all application summaries (C16-C19) together as study scope overview. Peer reviewers addressed C16 (spheroid formation) within their detailed evaluation of formation tracking results.

Minimal overlap on application overview (C17). OpenEval R10 includes C17 (fusion tracking) as part of study scope summary. Peer reviewers addressed C17 within their detailed evaluation of fusion tracking results.

Minimal overlap on application overview (C19). OpenEval R10 includes C19 (drug testing) as part of study scope summary. Peer reviewers addressed C19 within their evaluation of drug testing applications.

Minimal overlap on application overview (C18). OpenEval R10 includes C18 (dark core analysis) as part of study scope summary. Peer reviewers addressed C18 within their background evaluation alongside dark core mechanisms (C57-C59).
